Definition: the palm; by extension, a handful
BiblicalUsage: Shoal is a handful, the amount a hand can hold, and it shows up where small measures carry big weight. Ben-hadad boasted that the dust of Samaria would not give a handful to each of his men, the false prophetesses sold lies for handfuls of barley, and Isaiah asks who measured the waters in the hollow of His hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God works in handfuls and hollows of hands, and what looks too small to matter in our grip is nothing at all in His.
